ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:12; high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) occupy roughly 8% of the surface area compared to the dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear streaks concentrated in the central region adjacent to the notch and across the mid-lobes; localized brownish-white high-texture masses at distal extremities [left tip and right tip]; small circular white clusters scattered across the lower right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 2 to 10 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness on the distal thirds.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve fitted to both lobes, ascending from the median notch toward the elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially clustered circular white marks (diameter 3-6 pixels) localized primarily on the right lobe mid-section and near the median notch base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely packed white linear pixel disruptions; includes vertical parallel rake marks near the median notch and multiple intersecting diagonal scratches across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization clusters attached to the distal tips of both lobes; extensive white linear rake marks distributed across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Whale head with visible tubercles present in the lower right foreground; significant vertical white scarring cluster centered near the fluke junction.
